name: app-starter
description: Monorepo: RedwoodSDK app plus Flue agents, wired together with a Cloudflare service binding

scripts.dev: node scripts/require-account.mjs dev && turbo run dev
scripts.deploy:agents: node scripts/require-account.mjs deploy && turbo run deploy --filter=./packages/agents
scripts.deploy:app: node scripts/require-account.mjs deploy && turbo run deploy --filter=./packages/app
